name: Network waterfall
oneLiner: a dark glass network panel draws a slow request waterfall in real time with the long bars ringed red and a big load time counting up, then a fix slides every bar into a tight parallel stack, the load line jumps left and the number rolls down, goes green and a faster chip stamps in
say: when the speaker says they made something load faster ('it took almost five seconds, now it is under one'): the slow bars draw on the problem, the stack snaps tight and the number goes green on the result
